description: Plans responsive images. Pass `breakpoints` as min-viewport:width pairs such as `0:100vw, 768:50vw, 1200:600px` (vw or px), and optionally `dprs` (default 1,2), `sourceWidth` (original pixel width, upscaled candidates are dropped), `format` (jpeg, webp, avif, png; default webp), `aspect` (16:9 or 1.5, adds a height for layout stability), `urlPattern` containing {w}, `aboveFold` (true adds fetchpriority high and no lazy loading), `maxViewport` (default 1920) and `content` (photo, graphic or noisy). Returns the srcset widths (thinned so neighbors differ by at least 18 percent, max 8), the sizes string, an tag, and a rough byte estimate from typical bits per pixel for the format. Estimates are within about 2x either way. It plans markup; it does not resize files.
name: plan_responsive_images
title: Responsive image planner
